verdict.rationale: Log-based CDC is a fair question for a data-loading library like dlt, so the axis applies. The pack only documents query-based SQL extraction via SQLAlchemy backends and cursor-style incremental loading with merge/upsert. Nothing mentions binlog or WAL replication, or capturing deletes from a change log. Incremental merge is an adjacent feature, not log-based CDC, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I replicate databases with log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) so I capture updates and deletes without hammering the source
